No, [Darby Group Companies](https://www.linkedin.com/company/darby-group-companies-inc) (parent of [Darby Dental Supply](https://www.darbydental.com/manufacturers)) does not sell or distribute wearable medical devices. Their primary distribution and supply focus is centered on dental equipment, supplies, and basic clinical accessories like specialized gloves, rather than consumer or clinical patient-worn health tech.

- **Dental Supplies:** Over 50,000 traditional dental practice products.

- **Dental Equipment & Tech:** Capital equipment, imaging systems, and practice workflow software (such as Darby Dispatch).

- **Consumables:** Strategic partnerships for dental-specific wear like specialized examination gloves. [](https://compendiumlive.com/news/?newsID=104749)

If you are looking for **specific wearable medical device distributors** or need help finding a supplier for a **particular type of health monitor**, let me know what device you are searching for.

Darby Group Companies is a major dental supply and equipment distributor in the United States, and
it does not manufacture or specialize in continuous glucose monitors, smartwatches, wearable ECGs, sleep trackers, or remote patient monitoring (RPM) systems
If you are looking for medical-grade remote patient monitoring or wearable tracking tech, those solutions are provided by specialized healthcare and tech companies.
